### 💡 Codex Review Here are some automated review suggestions for this pull request. **Reviewed commit:** `2619444c4f`
ℹ️ About Codex in GitHub
[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".

nodes.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Scope semantic checks to their declared contract types**

For schema-valid user-defined mappings, these recursive checks can mistake map keys for structural fields. For example, an identity with `proportions: {"minimum": 0.5, "maximum": 2}` reaches this bounds check and raises an uncaught `TypeError` because the values are numbers, not vectors. Likewise, a link whose `entity_mapping` contains `{"created_at": "actor-2"}` incorrectly undergoes timestamp validation. This rejects otherwise valid documents and can bypass the CLI's structured error handling. Apply these checks to the corresponding typed contract nodes rather than inferring their types from dictionary keys.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify each distinct revision only once per binding-validation pass**

When multiple shot instances share a revision, this loop calls `revision()` separately for every instance, and each call fully reads and hashes the revision's external dependencies and review evidence. An isolated registry I/O check with 100 instances sharing one revision and a 1 MiB geometry file performed 200 verification passes and hashed approximately 200 MiB. With the supported 4096 instances and larger assets, even reading bindings can hash hundreds of GiB; registration and migration also perform this work while holding the SQLite write lock, blocking other writers. Cache verified revision results within each validation pass while still checking every instance's exact pin.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow selection recovery when the current revision's files fail verification**

If an external dependency or receipt belonging to the currently selected revision is missing or corrupted, this call prevents switching to a different, fully verified revision. `identity()` loads the current selection through `revision()` with external verification enabled, so deleting only the current revision's receipt makes `select()` raise `FileNotFoundError` even though the destination revision passes verification. This blocks the documented rollback operation precisely when it is needed to recover from a broken selection. Check the current pointer and its identity binding without requiring its external files to verify, while retaining destination verification and the transactional CAS check.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
